history.facts: BTC-USDT-SWAP settled realizedRate only; exact [start,end) events, fixed 8h grid, duplicate/missing rejection, no imputation. Immutable pre-I/O attempt, raw response/failure bytes, receive timestamps, counters, SHA256 receipts, parquet byte/logical hashes and dataset manifest. This is historical research acquisition, not live Paper funding completeness.

live.facts: Current allowlist is ticker plus candles; event_for has no funding payload. Independent fixed child has bounded time/output, runtime-token/config/selection guards, cancellation/reap and private immutable public-market-observations/<token>/<attempt>/capture/acquisition.json plus request audit. PublicMarketFeed summarizes actual counters; owner protection ticks remain separate.

canonical.facts: Close hardcodes PaperZero. Its E4 producer rejects alternate semantics. Existing E5 allocation profile accepts PAPER_MODEL with version/source-material hash, exact original plan/position/interval, completeness watermark, signed USDT cost and INCLUDED positive record count; ZERO_CONFIRMED requires proven zero records/cost. No E5 schema change appears necessary. Validator acceptance alone does not create a trusted producer.

minimum_application_increment: Add a separately versioned, explicitly selected public-rate Paper allocation producer; preserve PaperZero identity and never label it BROKER_LEDGER or actual account funding. Require successful initial settled-source capture before observation admission.

Extend the independent child with a fixed funding endpoint and immutable normalized event/coverage receipts; retain actual request accounting. Bind results to original run/position/config and persist accepted captures before allocation.

Replace only the ordinary close funding seam with trusted allocation evidence. Persist genuine flat/fills and a recoverable funding-pending condition before waiting; never resend a close or block protection on network availability.

missing_facts.intervals: Historical fixed 8h grid cannot prove variable live settlement schedules; retain actual event intervals and closed pagination coverage, not predicted rates.
missing_facts.notional: Historical convention is entry-fill price × base quantity. Event mark-price funding needs actual settlement mark and contemporaneous exposure/partial-fill history; ticker last is not settlement mark. Select an explicit labeled convention.
missing_facts.publication: Settled rates can publish late. Empty/missing pages do not prove zero; await actual completeness without inventing a watermark.
missing_facts.recovery: Bounded overlapping retries, durable deduplication/conflict refusal, source hashes and allocation idempotency must survive successor generations and backup/restore.

limits: Static mapping only; no policies selected, network activity, native execution, qualification or real-forward credit.
